text:
Harper Lin: quick QA on the SLO alert config row — added a compact "quick-preview" that shows threshold, duration, and a tiny channel pill. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/example/quick-preview
Noah Kim: saw it. tiny thing: the duration text gets lost at narrow widths, maybe collapse to '2h' and show full label on hover.
Zoe Martinez: accessibility: if the preview is activated via keyboard, ensure it receives focus and is announced. add role="region" and aria-label="Alert quick preview".
A11yBot: automated-a11y-check: 1978205000 — contrast warning on pill text; suggested darker token #253246.
Harper Lin: good call. also proposal: show an inline "Preview" affordance rather than hover-only so touch users can access it. small button with aria-expanded toggles the region.
Noah Kim: agree. microcopy nit: current header 'Threshold: p95 > 300ms' reads better as 'When p95 exceeds 300ms'. also make toast copy concise: 'Threshold updated'.
Zoe Martinez: keyboard flow: Enter toggles preview, Esc closes, Tab traps inside when open. announce success with aria-live polite. Also add a 250ms debounce when preview fetches to prevent spam on quick tabbing.
Harper Lin: action items: Harper - update palette + show token; Noah - land copy changes; Zoe - add aria labels & debounce. I'll update figma and create ticket. :thumbsup:
